framework_packaging: No Xposed framework class definitions included

checks.navigation: Native pager registry and indices preserved; hide-all fallback covered
checks.mine_entries: All 256 toggle combinations covered by unit tests
checks.actual_javascript: 44 real-script cases parsed; isolated layout expressions checked using stubs without executing app code
checks.page_isolation: Sport and Mine patches remain isolated
checks.migration: All legacy-master/migration/selection combinations checked; actual stored migration checked
checks.launcher: AdaptiveIconDrawable, solid orange background and monochrome layer verified on Android 16; independent module-settings entry remains available with launcher alias disabled
checks.device_checks: 0.6.2 settings UI checked: installed/tested labels, framework injection and prior selections retained. Target page checks come from iterative earlier builds; not rerun for other app versions.
checks.version_policy: No app version gate: package and main-process selection only; installed app switches stay available regardless of version. Method, return-type, resource-slot and script-fingerprint checks retained.

limitations: Listed app versions are tested versions, not a runtime whitelist; other app versions have not been fully validated.
Dynamic script changes can cause guarded rules to skip.
All toggle combinations were not separately verified visually on a phone.
No full business-function regression was performed.
No concrete baseline bottom Sport campaign was captured; no visual comparison claim for a specific campaign.
Third-party device plugins and other advertising placements are not exhaustively covered.
